_meta.purpose: Hardcoded test students for v0.1. The login code is the key. These are PERSONAS (made-up), not real minors, so we can demo and test safely before COPPA/FERPA work. Add or edit students here; no code change needed. NOTE: JSON files cannot contain code comments or a trailing sentence without becoming invalid and breaking the app, so the required change-notes and closing statement live inside this _meta block instead of as comments.
_meta.change_notes: 2026-08-03  COURSE-NEUTRAL PERSONAS (Jim's playtest: Maya's old note said 'ready for two-step equations like 2x+3=11' and Entry-Level Math dutifully taught algebra to a first-grade course). The progress notes were written in the single-course Algebra era but are injected into EVERY course's lesson, so they now describe personality and confidence only -- never a specific math topic -- letting each persona demo ANY course at that course's own level. Removed the grade field for the same reason (it skewed the tutor's developmental dials in the elementary courses). | 2026-07-19  Initial version. Four personas with starting progress notes.
